prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1451; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings. Diagnosis was cervical strain with associated muscle spasm.

Treatment consisted of a 24-visit course of care combining manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for deep cervical flexors and scapular stabilizers, and postural education. Modalities such as heat and ultrasound were used early in the course for symptom control. Over the treatment period, range of motion improved steadily, muscle spasm resolved, and headache frequency decreased substantially.

At discharge, the patient reported pain at a low intermittent level with return to usual daily activities and home exercise program adherence. Residual mild stiffness with prolonged computer use persists. A home exercise program and ergonomic recommendations were provided, with follow-up as needed for flare-ups.
